overview: Built an automated content system for producing branded legal reels for Facebook and Instagram.
The workflow takes an approved content idea and turns it into a complete short form video with the script, visuals, captions, hashtags, and branding handled automatically.

list: Retrieves approved content ideas from Google Sheets
Generates the reel script and scene structure
Formats scenes for vertical social media content
Combines the scenes into one video
Adds branding, logo, text overlays, transitions, and music
Stores the finished video reference in Google Sheets

result: A complete content production workflow that turns an approved idea into a branded, social media ready legal reel with minimal manual editing.
The system makes it easier to produce consistent content at scale while keeping the entire process organized in one workflow.
